acceptance_criteria.given: A user is on any page of the sandbox site
acceptance_criteria.then: They see a footer containing the current year and a GitHub link.
acceptance_criteria.when: They scroll to the bottom of the page

acceptance_criteria.given: The site is in light mode
acceptance_criteria.then: The text and link colors are legible and match the site's light theme palette.

acceptance_criteria.given: The site is in dark mode
acceptance_criteria.then: The text and link colors are legible and match the site's dark theme palette.

acceptance_criteria.given: The user clicks the GitHub link
acceptance_criteria.then: The GitHub repository page opens in a new tab.

assumptions.assumption: The 'current year' should be derived dynamically from the system date rather than hardcoded.
The footer should be a simple, single-line or centered component rather than a complex multi-section footer.

clarified_description: Add a global footer component to the Pixie sandbox Next.js site. The footer will display the current year and a link to the project's GitHub repository. It must be integrated into the root layout so that it is visible on every page, adheres to the existing Tailwind CSS design system, and supports both light and dark modes.

constraints.detail: Must use existing Tailwind CSS configuration and design tokens.

must: Appear on every page of the site via the root layout.
Use Tailwind CSS for styling to match existing site aesthetics.
Support both light and dark themes (using Tailwind dark mode utilities).
rationale:
The feature is a straightforward UI enhancement. I have prioritized dynamic year generation and theme support to ensure the component is low-maintenance and visually consistent. I assumed the link should open in a new tab as is standard for external repository links.

## Memory writes
- DECISION: Footer will be implemented as a standalone component in `components/Footer.tsx`.
- DECISION: Footer will be integrated into the root `app/layout.tsx`.
- FACTUAL: Footer includes a link to https://github.com/pixie-sandbox/pixie-sandbox-site.
should: Open the GitHub link in a new browser tab (target='_blank').
Include 'aria-label' or descriptive text for the link to ensure accessibility.
wont: Include additional links (e.g., Privacy Policy, Terms of Service) in this iteration.
Implement a complex multi-column footer layout.
